issues.title: OSPF: the expected neighbor is missing
issues.purpose: OSPF exchanges link-state information so routers can calculate paths. Neighbors must agree on required parameters.
issues.why: Absent or invalid Hellos prevent neighbor formation. An interface, area, timer, authentication or delivery mismatch can interrupt this exchange.
issues.check: Compare interface state and expected peer parameters on both ends. Identify the neighbor state before choosing a cause. Two-way can be normal between routers that are neither designated nor backup designated router on broadcast networks.
issues.action: In a synthetic lab, correct only the demonstrated mismatch against the approved design; preserve the original value for rollback.
issues.verify: Confirm the adjacency expected for this network type, required routes, and the user service. FULL alone is not application acceptance.
issues.scope: Commercial technology principle; confirm applicability, software release and approved baseline before use.

issues.title: OSPF: stuck exchanging the database
issues.purpose: Adjacency requires synchronizing routing information, beyond discovering a neighbor.
issues.why: A maximum transmission unit (MTU) mismatch can prevent database exchange. Exstart/Exchange is evidence to investigate, not proof of one cause.
issues.check: Compare both interface MTUs and the usable path size. Examine database-exchange observations on both peers before concluding MTU is responsible.
issues.action: Use the approved design to resolve the demonstrated cause. Do not make ignoring MTU checks the default fix.
issues.verify: Verify stable adjacency, expected routes and representative application traffic, including larger transfers.
issues.scope: Commercial technology principle; confirm applicability, software release and approved baseline before use.

issues.title: DMVPN: transport cannot reach the peer
issues.purpose: The outer network must deliver tunnel traffic before the overlay can work.
issues.why: An unreachable outer endpoint prevents subsequent tunnel stages.
issues.check: Compare bidirectional outer-path reachability separately from tunnel-address reachability.
issues.action: Restore the authorized transport path before changing overlay settings.
issues.verify: Recheck both directions, then tunnel and application acceptance.
issues.scope: Commercial technology principle; confirm applicability, software release and approved baseline before use.

issues.title: DMVPN: endpoint mapping is wrong
issues.purpose: NHRP associates overlay destinations with reachable transport endpoints.
issues.why: Missing or incorrect registration/mapping can prevent the intended forwarding path.
issues.check: Compare the expected peer and observed mapping for the approved DMVPN phase.
issues.action: Correct the demonstrated mapping fault using the authorized phase-specific design.
issues.verify: Verify required peer paths and user traffic, not only registration.
issues.scope: Commercial technology principle; confirm applicability, software release and approved baseline before use.

issues.title: Encryption: tunnel and security state disagree
issues.purpose: Encryption protects traffic; encapsulation alone does not establish protection.
issues.why: Incompatible security negotiation or a blocked path can prevent protected traffic. GRE status depends on release and configuration.
issues.check: Distinguish outer reachability, security-association state and bidirectional protected counters.
issues.action: Coordinate the approved correction. Never remove protection to make traffic pass.
issues.verify: Verify protected traffic in both directions and the intended service.
issues.scope: Commercial technology principle; confirm applicability, software release and approved baseline before use. Router IPsec and a dedicated TACLANE are separate protection mechanisms; these checks are not TACLANE procedures.

issues.title: Tunnels: small tests pass, applications stall
issues.purpose: Encapsulation needs packet space on the underlying path.
issues.why: Overhead can leave less room for inner packets.
issues.check: Compare small and representative-size synthetic transfers; success with small packets is insufficient.
issues.action: Resolve the demonstrated size limitation against the approved design.
issues.verify: Repeat representative transfers in both directions.
issues.scope: Commercial technology principle; confirm applicability, software release and approved baseline before use.

issues.title: TACLANE: isolate the fault boundary first
issues.purpose: A dedicated encryptor has a separate protection role from a router. This lesson teaches that distinction; it does not provide device setup.
issues.why: A failed service does not by itself prove a keying fault. Guessing at device or security settings obscures the original failure.
issues.check: In a fictional diagram, distinguish local connectivity, the transport path, encryptor status and remote service evidence. Actual status interpretation requires the approved model manual.
issues.action: Use the model/release-specific approved operator manual and qualified support. Do not bypass the encryptor or alter keying to test a theory.
issues.verify: Require the authorized protection checks and end-to-end service acceptance. No model-specific checklist is verified here.
issues.scope: Editorial fault-isolation exercise. Manufacturer training listing found; direct page access returned 403. No TACLANE operator procedure has been verified.

issues.title: COMSEC: readiness is a separate prerequisite
issues.purpose: COMSEC includes equipment and key-management responsibilities. A saved network configuration does not establish cryptographic readiness.
issues.why: Public product descriptions cannot establish which material, authorization or handling procedure a particular system needs.
issues.check: For a training scenario, identify the responsible COMSEC support role and the approved procedure needed before operation. Do not enter operational identifiers, keys or material here.
issues.action: Refer actual handling, keying, accountability and incident actions to authorized personnel and approved procedures. No fill, zeroize or recovery sequence is provided.
issues.verify: Use authorized acceptance criteria for the exact system. This app records no COMSEC readiness or operational status.
issues.scope: Public awareness only. Applicability differs by system; this is not a universal Army COMSEC checklist.
